properties.description: The #571 path, end to end. A session attached from a worktree on a fix branch edits a registered file, accepts its checksum and records the change through the shared server, then exports its worktree. PASS: tools/reflow2_check.py on that branch exits 0, with no import into a private store and no manual re-export. The main checkout's working copy is untouched by any of it. Reproduces fact:a-worktree-fix-recorded-its-design-changes-in-the-live-store-and-the-branch-gate-failed-2026-09-22.
properties.name: A fix made in a worktree through the shared server passes the coherence gate on its own branch, with no hand-made private store
